newsitem.title: UK: MTV allows advertisers to target French viewers.
newsitem.headline: MTV allows advertisers to target French viewers.

text.p: MTV Europe on Wednesday said it has launched a dedicated advertising "window" targeted at viewers in France, Belgium and French-speaking Switzerland.

The new "window" allows advertisers to target the 16- to 34-year-old audience in the French-speaking markets by reserving two minutes per hour for advertising aimed exclusively at viewers in these areas.

MTV Europe now has six regional advertising windows, including United Kingdom/Ireland, Scandinavia, Netherlands, Germany and Italy, as well as the new French window. Previously, advertisers and sponsors had to buy air time during MTV's pan-European trasmissions, regardless of their own availability or distribution in all of those territories.

"As Europe's leading youth media and marketing partner, we are extremely excited to offer companies in France and other French-speaking territories the opportunity to tap into the power of MTV as an advertising vehicle," Boris Kax, senior vice president of advertising sales for MTV Networks Europe, said in a statement."
MTV is distributed in France to 1.25 million homes via cable and the CanalSatellit digital satellite service.

MTV Europe said its on-going regional expansion strategy, under which it has used digital technology to create tailored programmes for northern, central and southern Europe, has made it possible to offer the regional services. A dedicated service for the UK is planned for mid-1997.
